title: Vision Plans Out-of-Network Contact-Lens Claims — Filing Window and Retroactive Start of Coverage
content:
**Member claims guidance, Vision Plans — contact-lens part**

| Order | Condition | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The claim reached Cascade more than 365 calendar days after the date of service | Nothing on the claim is reimbursed; lines denied for timely filing |
| 2 | Otherwise, the enrollment still stands applied, and the funding billing account's latest binder payment was not returned, is for at least the plan unit's monthly premium for its coverage tier, and was received on or before the binder deadline | A service dated on or after the coverage effective date is reimbursed, coverage having started retroactively on that date |
| 3 | Otherwise | The enrollment's own status and dates decide: reimbursed only when the enrollment is active or terminated and the date of service is on or after its coverage effective date and on or before its termination date when it has one; otherwise the lines are denied as not eligible and nothing is reimbursed |

**Definitions used**
- *Latest binder payment:* the funding account's latest payment with payment purpose binder, among the Premium Billing Accounts payments. It is returned when a returned-payment entry names it.
- *Binder deadline:* the coverage effective date plus 30 calendar days; a payment on the deadline day is in time.
- *Filing:* counted in calendar days from the date of service to the date the claim was received. Day 365 is in time and day 366 is late.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical).**
- A binder received 30 days after the coverage effective date meets the deadline; one received 31 days after does not.
- A binder equal to the unit's monthly premium meets the amount test; a lower one does not.
